summary: Registers the H224 media type for the RTP payload format of H.224. In video conferencing, far-end camera control commonly uses ITU H.281 over H.224. The document also defines the SDP parameters needed. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: In a video call you can tilt or zoom the other person's camera. This gives the camera-control messages their official type name and call-setup settings.
